title: Jess Wilson’s plan for Melbourne sewage plants risks water and wetlands without bringing debt down, experts say
summary_full: Academic says Victorian Liberal proposal to lease treatment plants and generate profit with no compromise of services ‘a total furphy’Victorian election 2026 guide: what you need to knowConfused about who to vote for? Check the parties’ key promises and policiesGet our daily political email, free app or daily news podcastExperts have warned the Victorian Liberals’ plan to lease Melbourne’s sewage treatment plants is a “smoke and mirrors” way to pay off debt that risks compromising the state’s water resources and crucial wetlands for nearly a century.On Thursday – two days out from the election – the opposition leader, Jess Wilson, announced plans for a 90-year lease of the Eastern and Western treatment plants, which process the vast majority of the city’s sewage and are run by Melbourne Water.
